subject: Renewal: phased capacity top-up + sync to OrchardAI contract
messages:
From: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@orchardai.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@orchardai.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: phased capacity top-up + sync to OrchardAI contract

Thanks, David — quick note as we kick this off. Our current contract expires 2026-11-30. We expect traffic to ramp significantly across Q4 as we pilot two new products.

High-level asks from our side: 
- Can we smooth increases across Q4 instead of a single large uplift? Prefer a 3-step ramp.
- We need co-term alignment with our other vendor contracts (end of Nov) and prefer no auto-renew on the new tranche.
- Any short-term burst capacity during the pilot window (mid-Oct) would be helpful — would accept credits or one-off purchase.

I'll loop procurement once we have a proposal. 

— Elaine
Elaine Torres
Head of Platform
OrchardAI
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@orchardai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: phased capacity top-up + sync to OrchardAI contract

Elaine — thanks for the clear asks. I've put together a short phased plan (attached) that: 
1) Splits the uplift into three tranches (Oct 1, Nov 1, Jan 1) to smooth spend and onboarding.
2) Co-terms the new tranches to 2026-11-30 so everything lines up at renewal.
3) Leaves the Q4 pilot burst as a one-time prepaid credit pool (can be invoiced separately if you prefer).

Two quick clarifications before we share with procurement/finance: 
- Do you need the Nov 1 tranche to be cancellable / opt-out before Nov 30? We can model an opt-out window but it affects pricing.
- For the pilot burst, do you want guaranteed capacity (SLA-backed) or a best-effort credit you can draw down?

Attaching the Excel with spend phasing and a draft amendment template. I'll bring in Karthik to confirm commercial flexibility.

Best,
David
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Renewal: phased capacity top-up + sync to OrchardAI contract

Looping legal and sales leadership — quick summary: OrchardAI wants a 3-step ramp, co-term to 11/30/2026, and no auto-renew for the new tranche. They're open to a prepaid burst credit for mid-Oct. 

Recommendation from commercial: we can offer a phased price with a small premium on cancellable tranches (to allow opt-out). We can also include a one-time pilot credit (up to $12k) if they commit to the Jan 1 tranche (50% of total uplift). 

Olga — can you confirm whether we can sign a short-form amendment that sets the co-term and explicitly opts the ramped capacity out of auto-renew, while preserving our standard renewal triggers on the base contract? Also note procurement will want clear invoicing cadence.

— Karthik
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T11:09:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal: phased capacity top-up + sync to OrchardAI contract

Karthik / David — legal is fine with a short amendment that: 
- Adds three "Tranche" lines with start dates and quantities.
- States explicitly: "Tranche quantities are non-recurring and will not auto-renew; they terminate on 2026-11-30 and will be considered for the next renewal unless otherwise agreed."
- Allows an opt-out clause for the Nov 1 tranche up to 14 days prior to start, with a 10% cancellation fee on that tranche.

I recommend we capture the pilot burst as a prepaid credit invoice with explicit drawdown rules — simpler than an SLA. Marissa / David, confirm pricing and I'll attach the updated amendment template.

— Olga
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@orchardai.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@orchardai.com>, procurement@orchardai.com
Date: 2026-09-02T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: phased capacity top-up + sync to OrchardAI contract

David — appreciate the rapid turnaround. OrchardAI is generally aligned with the proposed structure. A few final items before procurement engages: 
- We accept the 3-tranche model as long as the Nov 1 tranche has an opt-out (14 days) and the cancellation fee is capped at $10k (not 10% if that exceeds the cap).
- For bookkeeping we prefer the pilot credit invoiced as a separate PO line (one-time invoice).
- Can Redwood provide a short usage report template (weekly) during the pilot so we can monitor drawdown?

If you can confirm those three items and send the updated amendment, we'll route to procurement by EOD Tue.

Thanks — Jamal
Dir, Platform Ops, OrchardAI
